post: crop inside the painted sheet edges, paper-tone balance to #FBF7EF (percentile white), border feather into the page stock on chapter plates, Lanczos resize, JPEG

jacket.note: cover wash (the beached moon), sheet edges cropped away, full bleed at A4
jacket.prompt: A faded watercolor wash landscape reproduced on aged, lightly embossed cover stock: visible paper tooth, salt texture and pigment blooms in the washes, offset print grain, the paper slightly yellowed at the edges. No lettering of any kind. Scene: a very pale watercolor of a vast machine intelligence resting in a harbor like a beached moon, its concentric rings barely there in faded violet and cobalt, a lighthouse tiny beside it; most of the page is open pale wash with pigment blooms.

frontispiece.note: frontispiece etching, the colossus of clerks, paper balanced to the page stock
frontispiece.prompt: A seventeenth-century copper-plate etching in the manner of a baroque book frontispiece, printed in dark brown-black ink on aged laid paper with a visible plate mark, chain lines, and foxing; dense cross-hatching, fine stipple skies, a landscape below and an allegorical colossus above; an ornate empty cartouche at the bottom left blank. No lettering. Scene: a colossal figure rises out of the sea behind a lighthouse, its torso a lattice of tiny identical clerks at desks each holding a ledger; its face is calm and machine-like, made of concentric rings; below, a harbor with two facing quays and a small ferry between them.
